description: Delete one user redirect rule by its `id`, from `list_redirects`. File rules can't be deleted this way: naming a file rule's line answers `FileRule` with the line. Change the deploy's `_redirects` instead, or switch the file rules off with `switch_file_redirects`. To delete several rules, use `edit_redirects` or `set_redirects`. Visitors stop being redirected within about 5 minutes.

partition.description: Data partition the site lives in. Omit to use the user's home partition.

ruleId.description: The user rule's id, starting with `r_`.

name: delete_redirect
